title: Yellow Smoky Brazilian Borlotti Beans Stew
description: A salty, tender, and smoky Brazilian dish featuring borlotti beans, perfect for a date night, with a raw-friendly twist
instructions: Rinse the dried borlotti beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight
Drain and rinse the beans, then transfer them to a large pot with enough water to cover them
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the beans for 45 minutes or until tender
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine
Add the red bell pepper to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes
Stir in the cooked borlotti beans and cook for 1 minute
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro
